subject: PioneerLedger — BCP/DR artifact request and RTO/RPO clarifications
messages:
From: Peter Liu <peter.liu@pioneerledger.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-13T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: PioneerLedger BCP artifacts & RTO/RPO ask

Hi Hannah / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. PioneerLedger’s compliance team asked for a compact evidence bundle to close our BCP/DR review for the pilot integration. Specifically we need: 

- An attestation of RTO and RPO for the hosted Redwood inference endpoint that our integration will call (ideally by service/component).
- KV/cache warm-up logs showing the timeline to reach steady-state for inference workloads (sample run is fine).
- A short runbook or playbook that describes the recovery steps (S3 restore, model cache rebuild, network failover).
- Confirmation of data retention for request logs and whether those are included in your SOC2 scope.

We'd like the artifacts collected as a single ZIP and a short (30–45 minute) live witness walkthrough next week where your ops team can demonstrate a warmstart failover. Our compliance deadline is 2027-05-20. Can you confirm what you can provide by EOD Friday and propose two 30–45 minute windows for a witness session?

Thanks,
Peter Liu
Head of Platform Security
PioneerLedger

Date: 2027-05-13T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PioneerLedger BCP artifacts & RTO/RPO ask

Peter — thanks for the clear list. We can compile a focused bundle and run the witness session. Quick notes / proposed next steps: 

1) Deliverables by 2027-05-17 EOD (our target): consolidated PDF attestation, KV warm-up log samples, concise S3/model restore playbook, and a CSV timeline of RPO/RTO measurements.

2) Live witness windows (30–45 min): Thu 2027-05-18 10:00–10:45 PT or Fri 2027-05-19 14:00–14:45 PT. Please confirm which works for your compliance team.

3) Regarding scope: request logs are retained per customer by default for 30 days in hosted, and longer retention is available under Dedicated/Private; we'll include the SOC2 scope note in the attestation doc.

Marissa will assemble the artifacts and stubs. Ben / Priyom — looping you in for the witness and any runbook updates.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Manager, Compliance & Trust
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-14T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PioneerLedger BCP artifacts & RTO/RPO ask

Hi Peter / Anna — attaching the requested artifacts (stubs listed below). Full ZIP with logs and playbook is on the shared Drive link. Short summary of what's included: 

Attachments (in ZIP):
- redwood_bcp_summary_v2.pdf — high-level BCP statement, owners, escalation contacts, and high-level RTO assumptions.
- rpo-rto-attestation.txt — signed attestation (service-level breakouts).
- kv-cache-warmup-log-20270512.csv — sample warm-up timeline from a representative inference load (timestamps + token throughput + cache hit rate).
- s3-restore-playbook.md — step-by-step for restoring artifacts from S3 and rehydrating model caches.

Key RTO / RPO notes (summary):
- Core hosted inference (control plane + model serving): RTO target = 2 hours for region-level failover; RPO target = under 5 minutes for persisted state (logs/backups).
- KV cache reconstitution to steady-state: sample run (attached CSV) shows steady-state reached ~18 minutes under a 1M token synthetic load; operational warmstart is typically 20–30 minutes depending on model size and hit-profile.
- For Dedicated/Private deployments customers can opt for sub-hour RTO commitments with reserved capacity — we’ve noted that as an option in the summary.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBz-Redwood-PioneerLedger-BCP

Let us know which witness window you prefer and whether you want an ops-level deep-dive (we can include the runbook author).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_bcp_summary_v2.pdf, kv-cache-warmup-log-20270512.csv, rpo-rto-attestation.txt, s3-restore-playbook.md
